summary: Expose strict Manifest v1 canonicalization and SHA-256 identity with shared valid/invalid golden vectors, including the pinned reveal text-node digest, zero-reader rotation pilot and exact locator/CSS/safe-URL boundary pairs.

schema.detail: Shared manifest identity library and fixtures only; no registry or storage changes.

compatibility.detail: All manifest blank-text checks use the explicit ECMAScript TrimString whitespace set, including FEFF and excluding 0085. General text separately rejects controls; locator/reveal bounds reject NUL. Canonicalization and digest APIs validate the exact transmitted document before hashing. No active route or writer changes.

recovery.detail: Revert the library addition; no persisted state is changed.
